title: Minutes and seconds
description:
Read a number of seconds and print it as whole minutes plus leftover seconds:

```
200 seconds = 3 min 20 s
```

Integer division `/` gives the whole minutes; the remainder operator `%` gives what is left over.
hints: `200 / 60` is `3` (the decimals are thrown away) and `200 % 60` is `20` (what is left after taking out 3 whole minutes).
